name: Kagemori Village
description: Located at Yama’s southernmost point, Kagemori village has become a haunted place after the unearthing of a cursed Katana. Some believe it is a weapon used during the Ungods’ invasion; others assume this weapon came from the demons. During the day, it is a peaceful but empty village with many arts in porcelain and tapestries. A beautiful lake and cherry blossom trees stand out. At night, all this art becomes distorted, and evil spirits roam the place, seeking to consume souls. Among them are yūrei (vengeful spirits), kappa (water spirits that lure travelers to drown), and kodama (ancient tree spirits bringing misfortune to travelers). A cave leads to a vast labyrinthine dungeon where the katana is believed to be kept, and even nature becomes treacherous (as an example, the cherry blossoms fall continuously, putting the adventurers into a deep slumber). One common type of creature in the place is the jiangshi, usually with white and green skin and a paper talisman on its head.
